items.title: Paul Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: my favorite band of all was Jimmie Lunceford... We used to get a big thrill out of that.

ctx.x: Well you’ve certainly played behind some of the greats. When you were growing up in Southern California, what kind of music were you hearing over the airwaves?

Mostly the Benny Goodman type of thing. When I was a teenager I guess about 16, 17, 18, 19, in that area, that would be the late 30s, very early 40s, Glenn Miller, the old Glen Gray Casa Loma band, my favorite band of all was Jimmie Lunceford and Basie was around. I used to go out to the Mission Beach Ballroom with a friend of mine who liked all kinds of music but mainly swing, which was the thing in those days. And we’d stand under the bandstand for four hours, get a good spot under there at nine o’clock and we…
Were you forced into playing the piano or did it come—
